name: Ball Wide Mouth Mason Jars
description: Ball wide-mouth pint mason jars, 16 oz, 12 count, with lids and bands. The listing says the jars are BPA-free and made in the USA. Ball's lid page describes a sealing compound and does not say PFAS-free.
features: Amazon ASIN B071KTNCSC is a 12-count of 16 oz wide-mouth glass mason jars with lids and bands. The listing says they are BPA-free and made in the USA.

Ball's lid care page says canning lids are BPA-free and made in the USA, and that the underside has a softened sealing compound. It says canning lids are single-use because that compound molds to the jar.
Ball's regular-mouth canning lid page lists the lid material as tin-plated steel. The pages checked do not use the word PFAS.
The glass jar is the food-contact body. The metal lid and its sealing compound are the part to read. This directory has not tested either.
labelNote: BPA-free on a Ball lid is the brand's claim about BPA. It is not a PFAS test of the sealing compound.
